articles.title: Ducks Recall Myatovic From San Diego
PREVIEW: Ducks Look to Bounce Back Against Mammoth
Kraken Can’t Undo Early Damage By Sharks

out.detail: upper body injury, placed on injured reserve
upper body injury, day to day, not expected to play

away.summary: The Ducks (11-12-1) are coming off a 3-2 loss at Utah and have several key players sidelined, including Leo Carlsson, who is day to day with an upper-body injury and not expected to play. Nico Myatovic was recalled from San Diego and appears in the projected lineup, while Tyson Hinds and Noah Warren are scratched. Lukas Dostal is listed first among the projected goaltenders.

home.summary: The Kraken (10-9-1) are projected to use the same forward lines from their 5-1 win over Vancouver, with Joey Daccord listed first in goal ahead of Philipp Grubauer. Cale Fleury, Ville Ottavainen, and Curtis Douglas are scratched, while Jared McCann remains out with a lower-body injury.
